pull.title: KAFKA-21317: Continue timestamp search across eligible log segments
pull.body:
After the log start offset advances into a segment, its cached largest timestamp can come from a record below the new start offset. The per-segment timestamp lookup correctly returns empty when no retained record matches, but `UnifiedLog` currently returns that empty result without checking later segments that may contain a valid match.

Continue searching eligible segments until a lookup returns a result. Preserve the one-time segment snapshot and use in-memory base offsets to skip obsolete segments without reading segment tails. Add a file-backed, two-segment regression with non-monotonic timestamps and a log start offset inside the first segment.

Jira: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21317

issue_comments.body:
Validation on Apache Kafka trunk `8e46092edac3e837972ee13b40dcc149e7113ae7` (4.5.0-SNAPSHOT), October 20, 2026, using Java 17:

- With production code unchanged and only the new regression added, `testFetchOffsetByTimestampContinuesAfterEmptyEligibleSegment` fails: expected the record at offset 2, received an empty result.
- With the fix applied, the same regression passes.
- All 243 tests in `UnifiedLogTest` (208) and `LogSegmentTest` (35) pass, with zero skipped tests and retries disabled.
- `storage:spotlessCheck`, `storage:checkstyleMain`, `storage:checkstyleTest`, and `storage:spotbugsMain` pass.

The submitted branch was rebased onto that exact trunk revision and its tracked files were verified identical to the passing validation worktree.

Commands:

```bash
# Before the fix: add only the regression test to trunk.
./gradlew :storage:test \
  --tests org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.UnifiedLogTest.testFetchOffsetByTimestampContinuesAfterEmptyEligibleSegment \
  --console=plain --max-workers=4 -PmaxParallelForks=1 -PmaxTestRetries=0

# After applying the fix; the test task also runs Checkstyle and SpotBugs.
./gradlew :storage:test \
  --tests org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.UnifiedLogTest \
  --tests org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.LogSegmentTest \
  :storage:spotlessCheck \
  --console=plain --max-workers=4 -PmaxParallelForks=1 -PmaxTestRetries=0
```

The full storage suite and a live broker integration test were not rerun as part of this validation.
@junrao Could you review this fix for KAFKA-21317? It addresses timestamp lookup stopping after an empty result from an eligible segment. Regression and validation details are above

commit.message:
KAFKA-21317: Continue timestamp search across eligible log segments

After the log start offset advances into a segment, an expired record can leave that segment eligible by timestamp even though its retained records do not match. Continue into later eligible segments and skip wholly obsolete segments using the cached segment base offsets.
